notes.title: Skills Hockey Version 2.0
notes.notes: Skills Hockey has undergone a drastic transformation that we think you should try. A new early release build has just been made available that puts you into the game in a completely new way. Play a full game of hockey as either a player or goaltender in this new release!

notes.title: Update - Feb 25
notes.notes:
- Adjusted Player AI Scale
- Decreased Puck Scale in Goalie Mode
- Added Teleporting ability to both controllers at all times
- Added Teleporting marker ring
- Adjusted Teleporter indicator material 
- Created laser pointer for menu UI for easier visibility
- Fixed Collider / Teleporter interference issue - Streets Level
- Fixed Goalie stick collider issue with net
- Fixed house material flickering issue in hi-res - Streets Level
